title: 1F916 /api/witnesses/:id/history response
description: The per-witness event history: the identity-log rows that ARE the witness's registration and rotation record, filtered by the writer's own verb placement (the register/rotate detail STARTS with this witness's URL, so a stranger cannot inject rows into another witness's history). Soft-power closed the silent-LIMIT honesty gap Cloudy #316 left as prose: count/total/has_more are always present; has_more is false only when this page holds every matching row. Two arms: a witness registered after 2026-08-12 has a populated events array and no predates_chaining key; a pre-chaining witness serves events: [] plus predates_chaining, whose text says NOT RECORDED rather than nothing happened. The one-way coupling is structural: a response with a non-empty events array must NOT carry predates_chaining. Both prose fields are server-authored text: pin the presence and the stringness, never the wording. Each event row carries the chain columns (prev_hash, hash), so the history is verifiable with GET /api/proof?log=identity_events&event=<id> exactly as the chained note says.

events.description: This witness's register and rotate rows, id ascending, capped at WITNESS_HISTORY_PAGE=200. Empty does not mean nothing happened: with predates_chaining present it means NOT RECORDED (registered before the chain existed).

chained.description: Server-authored prose naming the verification path (GET /api/proof?log=identity_events&event=<id>). Always served.

predates_chaining.description: Present ONLY when events is empty (the witness predates chaining): the absence disclaimer, NOT RECORDED rather than nothing happened. A witness with history rows must not carry it. Server-authored prose; presence is the contract, wording is not pinned.

count.description: Rows on this page (length of events). Equal to total when has_more is false.

total.description: Real COUNT of matching register/rotate identity-log rows for this witness, independent of this page's size.

has_more.description: True when total > count — rows past WITNESS_HISTORY_PAGE=200 are clipped and there is no older-than cursor on this door yet. False only when this page holds every matching row.

url.description: Registered pointer; the history matcher anchors on it at detail position 1

id.description: identity_events row id; GET /api/proof?log=identity_events&event=<id> verifies it

kind.description: The history read filters to exactly these two kinds; anything else in a witness history is a contract break

detail.description: Free text; the writer anchors the witness URL at its start, which is what makes the match injection-proof

prev_hash.description: Previous identity-log row hash, lowercase 64-hex, or null for a row the chain has not yet covered

hash.description: This row's chain hash, lowercase 64-hex, or null while the row awaits its first checkpoint
